archetypes.name: dyn-prompt-relocation
archetypes.rationale: Relocated prompt authority must preserve mandatory-load routing and fail-closed contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the /implement prompt split across SKILL.md, bootstrap-recovery.md, and self-review.md. Focus on whether every moved branch is still mandatory-loaded before execution and whether the new references retain the original dirty-tree, degraded-prompt, and self-review composite contracts. Check that structure harness pins are strong enough to prevent duplicate authority returning to SKILL.md. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
